title: Uddur sinni cogda mekla
intro: massakaxxa le muuci, ken mabla kee sagacious fayuh yamixxige, inki adda horal taturtah tan fayitte tacee. Ken qangor, diini kutbeh addal yunkuttubeeh, cankâ maritte gadda geyuuy, sabrii kee gitah yan caalat fan miraacissa.
clues: Anu nabiinu hinna walel barkat gee.
Anu inni baxah kaxxa zambittet fayseh: Yallat wakliita haanam.
Anu taamoomih qilsa, walaa bisbaasa dariyyih melleb, kee Yalli mannal tet baahelem barseh.
Anu awka yaynabeenimih giclo oggolak Yalla kee inki xaleenah gadda gacsaanam diggoose.
yi fayi edde anuk salat xisaanam, maqaane amrisaanam, umaanek waaso kee sabrit inki num yakkem.
Qur'aanak inki mafdaga yi migaaqal muggaqsimte, yi barittoo kee anu tabse qasiiritte addat le.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
